description: Source code for the BidiFirefox class, which extends BrowserType to implement Firefox-specific browser automation features in Playwright, including environment setup, connection handling, and process management.

classes.name: BidiFirefox
classes.description: A class extending BrowserType to provide Firefox-specific browser automation capabilities within Playwright.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating the executable path is not specified.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser via a transport and returns a BidiBrowser instance.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include user-friendly messages for specific errors.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox, including crash reporter settings and handling Linux-specific variables.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the browser session.

methods.name: _attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Internal method to send shutdown commands over the transport.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported (returns false).

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory with Firefox preferences.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready and retrieves the WebDriver BiDi endpoint.
